key_insight: A DSL-guided, multi-agent LLM system can improve inverse design by turning natural-language materials rules into symbolic predicates that are checked against accumulated evidence.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical route to faster, more interpretable materials discovery for perovskite oxides, especially when task-specific training data are limited.
method: Translate design rules into chemistry DSL predicates
Use statistical evidence from materials data to validate or reject rules
Iteratively refine a multi-agent LLM workflow (ORCHESTRA) for inverse design
evidence_signal: In the abstract, the DSL-guided framework is reported to outperform a natural-language-only rule strategy, with especially better performance on harder target properties.
watch_item: Results depend on the quality of the predefined DSL and available materials data, so weak predicates or sparse coverage could still mislead the agent.
paper_title: Symbolic Predicate-Guided Language Agents for Inverse Design of Perovskite Oxides
